name: everest-plunge-pipely-xero-agent
description: Reconciliation service for Everest Plunge: checks that won Pipely deals have a matching invoice in Xero and flags anything that doesn't reconcile. Read-only against both systems — does not create or modify invoices. Automating invoice creation from Pipely deals is a separate, not-yet-confirmed decision (it would replace the current manual step where a rep raises the invoice inside Pipely).
